facts.text: Emporia State charges flat-rate tuition for on-campus undergraduates, capping tuition at 12 credit hours so additional credits carry no added tuition fee.

sources.title: Undergraduate Tuition + Costs - Emporia State University
sources.quote: At Emporia State University, you won't be charged for more than 12 credit hours as long as at least one hour is on campus.

facts.text: On-campus undergraduate students from anywhere across the contiguous United States pay in-state tuition at Emporia State.

sources.title: Undergraduate Tuition + Costs - Emporia State University
sources.quote: On-campus undergraduate students in the contiguous U.S.* pay the same affordable in-state tuition.
